mutualFund.title: What is a Mutual Fund?
mutualFund.analogy: Think of a mutual fund like a group meal. Many people pool their money together, and a professional cook (fund manager) decides what to buy. Each person gets a portion (units) proportional to their contribution. You don't need to know how to cook — you trust the cook's expertise.
mutualFund.detailed: A mutual fund pools money from many investors and invests it in stocks, bonds, or other securities. A professional fund manager makes investment decisions. You buy 'units' representing your share. Returns depend on the fund's performance. Mutual funds are subject to market risks — returns are never guaranteed. Different types exist: equity (stocks), debt (bonds), hybrid (both). Always read the scheme document before investing.
mutualFund.analogyHi: म्यूचुअल फंड को एक साझा भोजन की तरह समझिए। कई लोग मिलकर पैसे जमा करते हैं, और एक पेशेवर रसोइया (फंड मैनेजर) तय करता है कि क्या बनाना है। हर व्यक्ति को अपने हिस्से के अनुपात में हिस्सा (यूनिट) मिलता है। आपको खाना बनाना नहीं आना चाहिए — आप रसोइये की विशेषता पर भरोसा करते हैं।

sip.title: What is SIP?
sip.analogy: SIP is like filling a water pot drop by drop. Instead of investing a large amount at once, you invest a small fixed amount regularly (monthly). Over time, these drops fill the pot. When prices are low, you get more units; when high, fewer — this averages out over time.
sip.detailed: A Systematic Investment Plan (SIP) lets you invest a fixed amount in a mutual fund at regular intervals (typically monthly). Benefits: discipline, rupee-cost averaging (buying more units when prices are low), and the power of compounding over time. SIP does NOT guarantee returns — market fluctuations affect your investment. Start small, stay consistent, and match your SIP to your financial goals and risk capacity.
sip.analogyHi: SIP बूंद-बूंद भरते घड़े जैसा है। एक बार में बड़ी राशि लगाने के बजाय, आप नियमित (मासिक) छोटी राशि निवेश करते हैं। समय के साथ ये बूंदें घड़ा भर देती हैं। जब कीमत कम हो, ज्यादा यूनिट मिलते हैं; जब ज्यादा हो, कम — यह समय के साथ औसत हो जाता है।

volatility.title: What is Volatility?
volatility.analogy: Volatility is like a bumpy road. Some days the road is smooth, some days it's very rough. Your investment value goes up and down — that's normal. High volatility means bigger ups and downs. It doesn't mean you're losing money unless you sell during a dip.
volatility.detailed: Volatility measures how much and how quickly investment prices change. High volatility = large price swings. Low volatility = steadier prices. Equity (stocks) is more volatile than debt (bonds). Volatility is NOT the same as loss — you only realize a loss when you sell. Long-term investing helps ride out volatility. Never invest emergency savings in volatile instruments.
volatility.analogyHi: उतार-चढ़ाव एक टक्करदार सड़क जैसा है। कभी सड़क सुरक्षित, कभी बहुत टक्करदार। आपके निवेश की कीमत ऊपर-नीचे होती है — यह सामान्य है। ज्यादा उतार-चढ़ाव मतलब बड़े उतार-चढ़ाव। इसका मतलब नुकसान नहीं, जब तक आप गिरावट में न बेचें।

sebi.title: What is SEBI?
sebi.analogy: SEBI is like a traffic police for investments. Just as traffic police ensure drivers follow rules and don't cheat, SEBI ensures investment companies follow rules and don't cheat investors. If someone gives investment advice without SEBI registration, it's like driving without a license.
sebi.detailed: SEBI (Securities and Exchange Board of India) is the regulatory body for securities markets in India. It protects investor interests, regulates markets, and prevents fraud. Only SEBI-registered investment advisors can legally give investment advice. You can verify any advisor's registration on the SEBI website (sebi.gov.in). SEBI also runs SCORES (online complaint system) and manages IEPF (unclaimed funds).
sebi.analogyHi: SEBI निवेश के लिए ट्रैफिक पुलिस जैसी है। जैसे ट्रैफिक पुलिस सुनिश्चित करती है कि ड्राइवर नियम मानें और धोखा न दें, SEBI सुनिश्चित करती है कि निवेश कंपनियाँ नियम मानें और निवेशकों को धोखा न दें।

scamTypes.title: Common Scam Types
scamTypes.analogy: Scams are like different traps. Knowing the trap helps you avoid it. The most common: guaranteed returns, fake SEBI advisors, phishing links, pump-and-dump groups, and remote-access fraud.
scamTypes.detailed: Common investment scams in India: 1) Guaranteed returns fraud — no investment can guarantee returns. 2) Fake SEBI-registered advisors — always verify on sebi.gov.in. 3) Phishing — fake links to steal credentials. 4) Pump-and-dump — groups inflate a stock, then sell, leaving you with losses. 5) Remote-access fraud — scammers ask you to install apps like AnyDesk to 'verify' your account. 6) KYC fraud — fake SMS asking you to update KYC via links. Never share OTP, never install remote-access apps, never click suspicious links.
scamTypes.analogyHi: घोटाले अलग-अलग जाल की तरह हैं। जाल को पहचानना आपको बचाता है। सबसे आम: गारंटीड रिटर्न, फेक SEBI सलाहकार, फिशिंग लिंक, पंप-एंड-डंप ग्रुप, और रिमोट-एक्सेस फ्रॉड।

kyc.title: What is KYC?
kyc.analogy: KYC is like showing your ID at a building entrance. The security guard checks who you are before letting you in. Similarly, financial institutions verify your identity before letting you invest — to prevent fraud and money laundering.
kyc.detailed: KYC (Know Your Customer) is a mandatory identity verification process for financial services in India. You need Aadhaar, PAN, and address proof. KYC is done through KYC Registration Agencies (KRAs). IMPORTANT: SEBI and legitimate institutions NEVER ask you to complete KYC via SMS links or WhatsApp. If you receive such messages, they are scams. Always complete KYC through official portals.
kyc.analogyHi: KYC इमारत के प्रवेश द्वार पर ID दिखाने जैसा है। सुरक्षा गार्ड जांचता है कि आप कौन हैं। इसी तरह वित्तीय संस्थाएँ धोखाधड़ी रोकने के लिए आपकी पहचान सत्यापित करती हैं।

nominee.title: What is Nominee Registration?
nominee.analogy: A nominee is like giving someone a spare key to your house. If something happens to you, they can access it. In investments, a nominee can claim your investments if something happens to you — without long legal battles.
nominee.detailed: A nominee is a person you designate to receive your investments in case of your death. This avoids lengthy legal processes for your family. You can add nominees when opening accounts or update them later. Without a nominee, your family may need a succession certificate or legal heir certificate — a lengthy process. Update nominees after major life events (marriage, childbirth). Also check IEPF (Investor Education and Protection Fund) for unclaimed investments.
nominee.analogyHi: नॉमिनी अपने घर की चाबी किसी को देने जैसा है। कुछ होने पर वो घर खोल सकते हैं। निवेश में नॉमिनी को आपका निवेश मिल जाता है — बिना लंबे कानूनी झंझट के।
